candidates.name: Current DREDge AP
candidates.evidence: Official repo recommends SI dredge/dredge_fast, distinguishing older decentralized/rigid_fast. Our frozen decentralized routines are not automatically current DREDge.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: MEDiCINe rigid
candidates.evidence: Published likelihood-based detected-spike motion method; code integrates SI, default 30-second smoothing not automatically suitable for 90-second profile changes.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: Kilosort4 datashift
candidates.evidence: Widely used integrated motion method, compared in MEDiCINe paper; preprocessing/full spike representation differs.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: SpikeInterface decentralized rigid numerical solver
candidates.evidence: Frozen local official solver on identical count raster; only matched historical implementation.

current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: SpikeInterface 0.105.4 decentralized numerical routines on fixed count rasters
current_reference_limitations: Frozen solver is local specialist but not claimed current DREDge preset.
All eight simulations synthetic, same geometry and family; no in vivo drift validation.
Peak amplitudes/full voltage accessible to challengers would change information contract.
No scorer sign/scale/time alignment; only a constant gauge offset is allowed.
recommended_next_comparator: Prioritize current official DREDge rigid AP computation with identical histogram and displacement gauge. Compare rigid MEDiCINe using only same detected peak information in a separate input-parity tier; never supply true positions/events. Keep the 5 Hz grid followed by 1-second averaging and the sign/gauge metric exact.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
limitations: Frozen solver is local specialist but not claimed current DREDge preset.
All eight simulations synthetic, same geometry and family; no in vivo drift validation.
Peak amplitudes/full voltage accessible to challengers would change information contract.
No scorer sign/scale/time alignment; only a constant gauge offset is allowed.
negative_findings: No current published winner for the eight exact simulation seeds/processed rasters verified.
The new 2026 SLN + DREDge repository is in-preparation joint localization work, not a same-input benchmark winner.
